A Fast Voxel Traversal AlgorithmforRay Tracing
After an intersection is foundwe call the incremental traversal function again; this time we call the version with the extra comparison.If the intersection is in the current voxel, the function returns NIL and we stop. Otherwise, we continuetraversal until either we find a non-empty voxel or the voxel in which the intersection occurred.
